title: Internal: Debit Card Provisional Credit Guidelines
summary: This document explains Rho-Bank’s Regulation E rules for debit card disputes: provisional credit is required for qualifying disputes (unauthorized_transaction, various fraud/ATM/duplicate charge types) when reported within 60 days, written statement provided, and checking account OPEN with no holds. Timing: standard accounts within 10 business days (new accounts <30 days: 20); after provisional credit, investigation takes 45 business days (up to 90 for international/outside-US POS, new accounts). Provisional credit is for the full disputed amount, reversed if claim invalid, with written notice at least 3 business days prior; late reporting reduces by liability ($50 or $500).
